title: Setup guides
content:
# Setup guides

Follow these in order for every new server:

1. [[iDRAC9 setup]]: management address, accounts, time and logging.
2. [[BIOS and firmware baseline]]: update firmware and apply BIOS settings.
3. [[Storage layout]]: boot mirror and data drives.
4. [[OS installation]]: install Ubuntu through iDRAC virtual media.

Then complete the [[Site deployment checklist]] before handing the site over.
